facts.situation: Robert and Jean Fletcher seek long-term growth and require no portfolio income for the foreseeable future. Both remain comfortable with risk profile 4 (moderate). Jean has received a cleared inheritance, described in the meeting notes as around £120,000, following her mother's death earlier in the spring. Handle the bereavement and inheritance sensitively. They want to invest the inheritance alongside their existing portfolio. The joint GIA's latest meeting valuation was approximate.

actions.action: Disinvest the existing joint GIA, H-GIA-JF, in full.
Invest Jean's inheritance alongside the joint GIA proceeds to fund the agreed ISA top-ups and new joint investment account.
Top up Robert's ISA, H-ISA-R, and Jean's ISA, H-ISA-JE, for the new tax year.
Open a new jointly held investment account and invest the balance after the ISA top-ups.
